basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a college freshman from Oregon, just diving into the Reddit world. I love gaming, especially Overwatch, and I'm a huge fan of Hololive. Music is a big part of my life—I'm into alternative rock, and The Velvet Underground is my favorite band. I spend my free time watching streams or exploring new subreddits. I usually browse Reddit during late nights, as I'm a night owl. Currently single and focusing on my studies in computer science.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm a first-year computer science student with a burgeoning interest in technology and gaming. Most of my knowledge comes from my coursework and self-teaching through online resources. I've recently started exploring the world of VR and AR through various forums.
